subject: Mid-q pulse: priority grid & dependency asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-q pulse: priority grid & dependency asks

Team —

Attached is a compact priority grid for our mid-quarter QBR prep (QBR_priority_grid.xlsx). This is intentionally short: I want two things from each owner by EOD Thursday (Oct 8):

- A one-line status (On track / At risk / Re-scope) for the OKR initiatives you own.
- Any immediate dependency asks we need to lock (infra, legal, procurement, partner work) with an owner and ETA.

Highlights / immediate proposals:
- Product Velocity OKR: propose re-scoping the cross-pod refactor to a narrower MVP to preserve mid-q delivery. Owner: Laura.
- Model Serving Latency OKR: suggest piloting quantized model on a single workload rather than full rollout to avoid increased infra spend. Owner: Vanessa.
- Sales Enablement OKR (Pinecrest Health ramp): need procurement & security answers for data retention and audit logs to finalize SOW. External engagement: Susan Lewis.

If you think a re-scope would break downstream commitments, note that explicitly and propose corrective mitigation (e.g., schedule, alternate owner, or trade). I will collate and circulate a one-page readout for the Exec QBR on Fri morning.

Attachments: QBR_priority_grid.xlsx (tabbed grid, owners + risk column).

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q pulse: priority grid & dependency asks

Markus — thanks for the clear ask. Quick status from Product Velocity side:

- Status: At risk (scope creep on the cross-pod refactor is the main driver).
- Proposed re-scope: Deliver core data contracts + one integration path (Payments) this quarter; defer multi-integration testing to Q4.
- Dependencies: Need 2 frontend engineers for 6 weeks and a reserved infra slot for canary testing (INFRA-78).
- Owner commitment: I can lead the narrower MVP if we get the infra slot by Oct 20 and the FE hires / temp contractors in place by Oct 12.

I’ve attached the infra runbook excerpt that shows the canary requirements (infra-runbook.pdf) and added a short note in the grid. I flagged SUP-321 as the support handoff that must be closed before the final rollout.

If we can’t get the infra slot, we’ll have to push the MVP out of this quarter — which would affect our velocity OKR projection in the QBR.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q pulse: priority grid & dependency asks

Markus / team —

Thanks for the grid. Quick note on Model Serving Latency: I’m uneasy with a blanket rollout deferral. The Pinecrest Health proof-of-concept is already lined up for a performance baseline next month, and we promised sub-200ms p95. If we only pilot quantized models on one workload we might hit cost targets but risk SLOs for that customer.

Proposed middle-ground:
- Keep the latency OKR but move to a staged rollout: pilot quantized serving for internal benchmark workloads and for Pinecrest Health in parallel (two-week pilot).
- Commit to a fallback plan (route to latest full-precision variant) for customer-critical traffic during the pilot.
- Dependency ask: we need one dedicated GPU slot for the pilot window (2 weeks) and a legal sign-off on the pilot escalation path. ETA: GPU slot by Oct 14, legal notice by Oct 12.

If legal or infra cannot commit to those ETAs, I will mark the initiative as At risk rather than re-scope.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q pulse: priority grid & dependency asks

Markus / Vanessa —

Appreciate the transparency and the staged approach. From Pinecrest Procurement / IT: we can accept a two-week pilot of quantized models as long as Redwood provides:

1) A short SOW addendum that limits scope to the pilot and includes audit log retention (see attached pinecrest_scope_v1.docx).
2) A clear escalation path and rollback plan to full-precision serving if we detect any regression in clinical workload latency.

We are available for a quick alignment call Friday (Oct 9) afternoon; Susan and our Technical Lead can join. If Redwood can provide the GPU slot and the pilot SOW addendum draft by Friday noon, Procurement will fast-track sign-off.

Thanks —
Susan Lewis
Procurement Manager
Pinecrest Health
